production.note: US model years. The release introduces the '2022 Golf GTI and Golf R'. Still on sale (Volkswagen's US Golf R press kit, vw-us-golf-r-model-page).

body.note: Golf hatchback; inferred from the release.

displacementL.note: 1,984 cc: 'the EA888 evo4 engine displaces 1,984 cc' (2026 Golf R press kit); the 2022 release calls it the '2.0-liter' EA888 (vw-us-2022-golf-gti-r-chicago).

fuel.note: Inferred: a TSI gasoline engine with no hybrid system.

drivetrain.note: '4Motion all-wheel-drive system with rear-axle torque vectoring'

transmission.note: 'can be paired with a standard six-speed manual transmission or an optional seven-speed DSG® dual-clutch automatic' (DSG is a DCT). The manual ended after the 2024 model year: Motor1 quotes Volkswagen, "the manual transmission will not be available after MY2024 for Golf GTI and Golf R" (motor1-2025-golf-auto-only); Carscoops on the 2025 US cars: "The R also loses its manual option" (carscoops-2025-golf-us). The 2026 press kit lists only 'a 7-speed DSG dual-clutch automatic transmission' (vw-us-golf-r-model-page). Both gearboxes are kept because the record covers 2022 onward.

powerHp.note: Quote: "now makes 315 horsepower". 315 hp is the launch rating (2022-2024). From the 2025 model year the US car is rated 328 hp: Carscoops, "the 2025 hatch makes the same 328 hp (333 PS)" (carscoops-2025-golf-us); Car and Driver's 2025 Golf R road-test panel, "Power: 328 hp @ 6500 rpm" (cd-golf-r-2025, DSG); Volkswagen's current US press kit, 'now produces 328 horsepower (achieved using premium fuel) at 5,850 rpm' (vw-us-golf-r-model-page). The record keeps the 2022 reference year (315 hp, manual weight); the 2025 DSG car's C/D road-test curb weight is 3,377 lb (cd-golf-r-2025).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL, from databases. Golf R with the 6-speed manual. Cars.com: "Base Curb Weight: 3,417 lbs" (2022 Golf R, 'Transmission Options: M/T 6-Speed M/T'). MotorMatchup gives the same: "Curb Weight: 3,417 lbs" for the 2022 Golf R 2.0T Manual (motormatchup-2022-golf-r-manual).
